post.text:
For the first time, the objectspace Object Book Fair is coming to Ōtautahi Christchurch! The celebration of book design will be at the Sir Miles Warren Gallery, 65 Cambridge Terrace. www.objectspace.org.nz/events/otaut...
It's on Saturday 4 and Sunday 5 July (with events before too). ^DR
#pukapuka
